title: Use saved files as the KiCad 10 synchronization boundary
rationale: Supported KiCad 10 interfaces cannot prove unsaved Schematic, Symbol, or Footprint Editor state. Scan after saves, label results as last-saved state, never modify an open design behind KiCad, and use guided native replacement or a guarded closed-project transform. Defer library activation until KiCad closes when editor cleanliness is unknown.

title: Render symbol and footprint previews with the installed kicad-cli
rationale: Previews are SVGs from `kicad-cli sym export svg [-s SYMBOL]` and `kicad-cli fp export svg [--fp NAME]`, which use KiCad's own drawing code, so they match what KiCad shows without an app-side renderer. KiCad's chooser preview panes can't be embedded in another app. Find kicad-cli in standard install locations (Windows: Program Files\KiCad\<version>\bin) plus a user override. Cache SVGs by library content hash and KiCad version, and export whole libraries in batches. Measured on KiCad 10.0.4 on 2026-10-08: about 0.25 s per part, and about 11 s for all 35 repository libraries (241 SVGs). `kicad-cli pcb render` can provide 3D images later through a temporary board.
